---
title: "Ideas & Polls"
page-layout: article
---

Every member has an equal voice. Sign in, share your idea, and vote on proposals from fellow members. Ideas are reviewed by moderators before publication.

```{=html}
<style>
  .poll-app { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .poll-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3d6c6; border-radius: 12px;
               padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; margin: 1rem 0;
               box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(91, 58, 30, 0.08); }
  .poll-card h3 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #5b3a1e; }
  .poll-meta, .poll-note { color: #7a6a5a; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .poll-body { white-space: pre-wrap; }
  .poll-input { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5rem 0;
                padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid #cdbba5; border-radius: 8px;
                font: inherit; }
  .poll-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #1f6f8b; border-color: #1f6f8b; }
  .poll-btn { border: 1px solid #cdbba5; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px;
              padding: 0.4rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 0.4rem; }
  .poll-btn:hover { background: #f4e9dc; }
  .poll-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .poll-btn.primary { background: #5b3a1e; border-color: #5b3a1e; color: #fff; }
  .poll-btn.primary:hover { background: #8a5a2b; }
  .poll-btn.up.active   { background: #2e7d4f; border-color: #2e7d4f; color: #fff; }
  .poll-btn.down.active { background: #b23b2e; border-color: #b23b2e; color: #fff; }
  .poll-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
  .poll-score { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 700; color: #5b3a1e; }
  .poll-toolbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 2rem; }
  .poll-msg { min-height: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .poll-msg.ok { color: #2e7d4f; }
  .poll-msg.error { color: #b23b2e; }
</style>

<div class="poll-app">
  <div id="poll-auth" class="poll-card"></div>
  <div id="poll-submit" class="poll-card" hidden></div>
  <div id="poll-msg" class="poll-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div class="poll-toolbar">
    <strong>Member ideas</strong>
    <select id="poll-sort" class="poll-input" style="width:auto; margin:0;" aria-label="Sort ideas">
      <option value="score">Top rated</option>
      <option value="new">Newest</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div id="poll-list"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.min.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const sb = supabase.createClient("https://kyczmkoyitspgyaqlqaj.supabase.co", "sb_publishable_-BTZxrU2m7rJMwiIB7a_tA_PSgqWBNp");
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  let session = null, myVotes = {}, sortBy = "score";

  // Builds DOM nodes; strings are always inserted as plain text, never as HTML.
  function el(tag, props = {}, ...kids) {
    const n = document.createElement(tag);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props)) {
      if (k === "class") n.className = v;
      else if (k.startsWith("on")) n.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
      else n.setAttribute(k, v);
    }
    kids.flat().forEach((c) => n.append(c));
    return n;
  }

  function showMsg(text, kind = "") {
    const m = $("poll-msg");
    m.textContent = text;
    m.className = "poll-msg " + kind;
  }

  function renderAuth() {
    const box = $("poll-auth");
    box.replaceChildren();
    if (session) {
      box.append(
        el("span", {}, "Signed in as ", el("strong", {}, session.user.email), "  "),
        el("button", { class: "poll-btn", onclick: () => sb.auth.signOut() }, "Sign out")
      );
      return;
    }
    const email = el("input", { type: "email", class: "poll-input", placeholder: "you@example.com",
                                "aria-label": "Email address", autocomplete: "email" });
    box.append(
      el("p", {}, "Sign in with your email to submit ideas and vote. We'll send a one-time link, so no password is needed."),
      email,
      el("button", { class: "poll-btn primary", onclick: async () => {
        const addr = email.value.trim();
        if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(addr)) return showMsg("Please enter a valid email address.", "error");
        const { error } = await sb.auth.signInWithOtp({
          email: addr, options: { emailRedirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname }
        });
        showMsg(error ? "We couldn't send the link. Please try again shortly."
                      : "Check your inbox for your sign-in link.", error ? "error" : "ok");
      }}, "Send sign-in link")
    );
  }

  function renderSubmit() {
    const box = $("poll-submit");
    box.replaceChildren();
    box.hidden = !session;
    if (!session) return;
    const name  = el("input", { class: "poll-input", maxlength: 40, placeholder: "Display name (shown publicly)", "aria-label": "Display name" });
    const title = el("input", { class: "poll-input", maxlength: 120, placeholder: "Idea title", "aria-label": "Idea title" });
    const body  = el("textarea", { class: "poll-input", rows: 5, maxlength: 2000,
                                   placeholder: "Describe your idea (20–2,000 characters)", "aria-label": "Idea description" });
    const btn = el("button", { class: "poll-btn primary", onclick: async () => {
      const n = name.value.trim(), t = title.value.trim(), b = body.value.trim();
      if (n.length < 2 || t.length < 5 || b.length < 20)
        return showMsg("Please add a display name (2+ characters), a title (5+), and a description (20+).", "error");
      btn.disabled = true;
      const { error } = await sb.from("ideas").insert({ author_name: n, title: t, body: b });
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (error) return showMsg(
        /limit/i.test(error.message) ? "You've reached the daily limit for new ideas. Please try again tomorrow."
                                     : "Your idea couldn't be submitted. Please try again.", "error");
      title.value = ""; body.value = "";
      showMsg("Thank you! Your idea was submitted and will appear after review.", "ok");
    }}, "Submit idea");
    box.append(
      el("h3", {}, "Share an idea"), name, title, body, btn,
      el("p", { class: "poll-note" }, "All ideas are reviewed by moderators before they appear.")
    );
  }

  function renderList(ideas) {
    const list = $("poll-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    if (!ideas.length) {
      list.append(el("p", { class: "poll-note" }, "No ideas have been published yet. Be the first to submit one!"));
      return;
    }
    ideas.forEach((i) => {
      const mine = myVotes[i.id];
      list.append(el("article", { class: "poll-card" },
        el("h3", {}, i.title),
        el("p", { class: "poll-meta" }, `by ${i.author_name} · ${new Date(i.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}`),
        el("p", { class: "poll-body" }, i.body),
        el("div", { class: "poll-actions" },
          el("button", { class: "poll-btn up" + (mine === 1 ? " active" : ""),
                         "aria-pressed": String(mine === 1), onclick: () => vote(i.id, 1) }, `▲ Support (${i.up})`),
          el("button", { class: "poll-btn down" + (mine === -1 ? " active" : ""),
                         "aria-pressed": String(mine === -1), onclick: () => vote(i.id, -1) }, `▼ Oppose (${i.down})`),
          el("span", { class: "poll-score" }, `Net ${i.score > 0 ? "+" : ""}${i.score}`)
        )
      ));
    });
  }

  async function load() {
    let q = sb.from("public_ideas").select("*");
    q = sortBy === "new" ? q.order("created_at", { ascending: false })
                         : q.order("score", { ascending: false }).order("created_at", { ascending: false });
    const { data, error } = await q.limit(100);
    if (error) return showMsg("Ideas couldn't be loaded right now.", "error");
    myVotes = {};
    if (session) {
      const { data: mine } = await sb.from("votes").select("idea_id,value");
      (mine || []).forEach((v) => { myVotes[v.idea_id] = v.value; });
    }
    renderList(data || []);
  }

  async function vote(id, value) {
    if (!session) return showMsg("Please sign in to vote.", "error");
    const { error } = myVotes[id] === value
      ? await sb.from("votes").delete().eq("idea_id", id)   // clicking again retracts
      : await sb.from("votes").upsert({ idea_id: id, user_id: session.user.id, value },
                                      { onConflict: "idea_id,user_id" });
    showMsg(error ? "Your vote couldn't be recorded." : "", error ? "error" : "");
    await load();
  }

  async function refresh() { renderAuth(); renderSubmit(); await load(); }

  $("poll-sort").addEventListener("change", (e) => { sortBy = e.target.value; load(); });

  sb.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, s) => {
    session = s;
    if (["INITIAL_SESSION", "SIGNED_IN", "SIGNED_OUT"].includes(event)) setTimeout(refresh, 0);
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Results at a glance

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(httr2)
library(tidyverse)

key  <- "sb_publishable_-BTZxrU2m7rJMwiIB7a_tA_PSgqWBNp"
base <- "https://kyczmkoyitspgyaqlqaj.supabase.co/rest/v1/public_ideas"

resp <- request(base) |>
  req_url_query(select = "id,title,up,down,score", order = "score.desc", limit = 10) |>
  req_headers(apikey = key) |>
  req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
  req_perform()

if (resp_status(resp) != 200) {
  cat("Results are temporarily unavailable.")
} else {
  ideas <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = TRUE)

  if (length(ideas) == 0) {
    cat("No published ideas yet.")
  } else {
    p <- ideas |>
      mutate(label = str_trunc(title, 45), down = -down) |>
      pivot_longer(c(up, down), names_to = "vote", values_to = "n") |>
      ggplot(aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(label, score), fill = vote)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(up = "#2e7d4f", down = "#b23b2e"),
                        labels = c(up = "Support", down = "Oppose"), name = NULL) +
      labs(x = "Votes", y = NULL, title = "Top ideas") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    print(p)
  }
}
```

*This chart updates each time the site is rebuilt.*

*By signing in you agree that your email is used only for login and that your display name appears with ideas you submit. Individual votes are never public.*
